post noun

letters and parcels delivered

also mail, the mail, the post, stack of mail, letters (post), postage, deliver the mail, forward mail, pay the postage, postal delivery

classical

Traupman 167

epistulae, epistulārum f. pl.

noun, first declension, plural · Declension on Wiktionary

letters, the post

Other words

  • rēs cursuālēs — postal items, mail

    also used · modern · Traupman 167

  • vectūra litterārum — postage

    also used · modern · Traupman 167

    vectūra is classically carriage or its fare (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • multijugae litterae

    a stack of mailTraupman 167

  • rēs cursuālēs reddere

    to deliver the mailTraupman 343

  • rēs cursuālēs dēferre

    to forward the mailTraupman 343

  • prō vectūrā epistulae solvere

    to pay the postageTraupman 363

  • perlātiō cursuālis

    postal deliveryTraupman 363

See also post office, post a letter, postbox, parcel.
